title: I Didn’t Think Things Would Get This Chaotic When We Elected President...
content: I Didn’t Think Things Would Get This Chaotic When We Elected President Donkey Kong. “But for all the talk from pundits about how we’d see a new side of Donkey Kong once he took office, well, not so much. Turns out we got exactly what we voted for.”
author: Jason Kottke
